name: order_escort
summary: Order Escort is an order management utility EA that accompanies and manages existing orders by applying trailing stops, break-even logic, and partial close functionality. It does not open its own positions but instead monitors and adjusts open trades according to user-defined parameters. The EA acts as an automated trade escort, protecting profits and managing risk on manually or externally opened positions.
summary_zh: Order Escort是一个订单管理工具型EA，通过应用移动止损、保本逻辑和部分平仓功能来伴随和管理现有订单。它不会自行开仓，而是根据用户定义的参数监控和调整已有交易。该EA作为自动化交易护卫，保护利润并管理外部开仓头寸的风险。
strategy_analysis: 该EA是一个订单管理工具，不基于任何交易策略自行开仓。其核心功能是对已有订单执行移动止损（Trailing Stop），当价格朝有利方向移动时逐步跟进止损位以锁定利润。保本功能（Break-Even）会在价格达到一定盈利点数后将止损移至开仓价，确保交易至少不亏损。部分平仓功能允许在达到特定盈利目标时关闭部分仓位，实现利润分批兑现。仓位管理方面，该EA不涉及开仓手数计算，但通过止损调整间接管理持仓风险。资金管理依赖于移动止损和保本参数的合理设置，不包含净值比例或风险百分比等动态资金管理模块。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is an order management utility that does not open positions based on any trading strategy. Its core function is executing trailing stops on existing orders, progressively moving the stop loss level as price moves in the favorable direction to lock in profits. The break-even feature shifts the stop loss to the entry price once a specified profit threshold in points is reached, ensuring the trade at minimum breaks even. The partial close functionality allows closing a portion of the position at specific profit targets, enabling staged profit realization. In terms of position management, the EA does not handle lot size calculation for new entries, but indirectly manages holding risk through stop loss adjustments. Money management relies on the proper configuration of trailing stop and break-even parameters, and does not include dynamic money management modules such as equity percentage or risk percentage calculations.

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: 魔术编号，0表示管理所有订单
parameters.description_en: Magic number; 0 to manage all orders

pros: 移动止损和保本功能有效保护已有利润，减少回撤风险
部分平仓功能实现利润分批兑现，兼顾盈利和继续持有
作为工具型EA可与任何交易策略配合使用，灵活性高
参数设计直观，移动止损步进和保本偏移允许精细调整
pros_en: Trailing stop and break-even features effectively protect existing profits and reduce drawdown risk
Partial close functionality enables staged profit realization, balancing between taking profit and holding positions
As a utility EA, it can work alongside any trading strategy, offering high flexibility
Parameter design is intuitive, with trailing step and break-even offset allowing fine-grained adjustments
cons: 不具备自主交易能力，完全依赖外部开仓信号或手动操作
缺乏动态资金管理模块，无法根据账户净值自动调整止损幅度
部分平仓后剩余仓位缺少独立管理逻辑，可能导致尾部风险
没有考虑点差和手续费对保本止损位的实际影响
cons_en: Lacks autonomous trading capability, entirely dependent on external signals or manual operations for opening positions
Missing dynamic money management module, unable to automatically adjust stop levels based on account equity
Remaining position after partial close lacks independent management logic, potentially leaving tail risk
Does not account for spread and commission impact on the actual break-even stop level
improvements: 增加基于账户净值百分比的动态止损调整功能，使风险管理更灵活
为部分平仓后的剩余仓位添加独立追踪止损参数，优化尾部利润保护
improvements_en: Add dynamic stop loss adjustment based on account equity percentage for more flexible risk management
Implement independent trailing stop parameters for the remaining position after partial close to optimize tail profit protection

risk_points: 保本止损位未考虑点差和手续费，实际可能略低于开仓成本
部分平仓后剩余仓位若无后续管理可能在行情反转时全部回吐利润
risk_points_en: Break-even stop level does not account for spread and commission, which may result in a stop slightly below actual entry cost
Remaining position after partial close without subsequent management may give back all profits during a reversal

It does not open its own positions but instead monitors and adjusts open trades according to user-defined parameters. The EA acts as an automated trade escort, protecting profits and managing risk on manually or externally opened positions.
